title: Shop Efficiency report shows only a Date filter
permissions_required: Any signed-in user with access to the Reports pages. Whether the filter option lists differ by role is to confirm — pending Branko's PRD.
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. You are on the Reports area of the app with some sample data present.
steps: 1. Open the Reports area and go to the Shop Efficiency report.
2. Look at the filter buttons shown above the report table.
expected: 1. The Shop Efficiency report shows a single filter button: Date.
2. The table shows columns: Total Clocked Hours, Total Invoiced Hours, Difference and Efficiency.
spec_ref: Filters (Epic key TBD); Figma 11903-10573 (Reports filters); design-notes.md §B.6 #7
notes: Design-only. Only one filter (Date) on this report. Option lists pending Branko's PRD.
